scope: Every published pipeline variant under skills/

criteria.runs: Validates and executes on Expanso Edge with sample input, or has dated end-to-end job proof.
criteria.platform_realism: Named services use deployable APIs, authentication, TLS, storage, and safe defaults.
criteria.structure: Not applicable: this site has no stage explorer.
criteria.site_usability: Shared copy feedback, WCAG AA, and 320px wrapping are browser-tested in light and dark themes.
criteria.regression_history: Deep links, Spec and Pipeline tabs, theme persistence, and job proof survive the redesign.

retained_features: CLI, MCP, cloud, and job pipeline downloads
